youtube.title: What If You Were Dropped Into a Zombie Invasion? 🧟 #shorts
youtube.description:
If you got dropped into a zombie invasion in the USA, this is what would happen 😳

Within about a day, the lights start going out, because nobody is left running the power plants and the grid needs people to keep it balanced. Then your phone dies: most cell towers only have a few hours of battery backup. Need food? Most grocery stores only keep about three days of stock on the shelves.

And the crazy part: the Pentagon really did write a zombie war plan. It's called CONPLAN 8888, 'Counter-Zombie Dominance', and it was written in 2011 as a training exercise for military planners. The CDC even published a zombie preparedness guide the same year 🧟

So your best bet might be getting to the Pentagon. The question is: how do you get there?
